findings.issue: Head registration uses the face bounds center and width/height only. Core head transfer does not register eye, nose, mouth, chin and jaw correspondences.
Registered depth and displacement fields are averaged from the two references; this alone does not separate identity-dependent shape from pose motion.
Positive cell constraints prevent local inversion at checked keys but do not constrain identity, facial feature ratios, seams, or all interpolated and combined poses.
Sampling clamps outside the template domain; template-domain coverage is not a semantic face correspondence or applicability test.

findings_scope: Pre-semantic run-20261003-common-reference-5; retained as the audit that triggered the shared redesign

grid_part_authority_correction.grid_rule: Face Grid angle keys from fixed depth and reference bone curves through NJC only
grid_part_authority_correction.part_rule: Preserve reference-derived local Part corrections separately; no blanket prohibition

remediation_in_progress.implementation: shared semantic TPS charts for head, torso and four limbs; continuous fields with adaptive error-bounded sampling
remediation_in_progress.landmark_observation_limit: facial material envelope endpoints and centers; not learned landmark detection or arbitrary contour recognition

required_before_generalization_acceptanc: Register semantic face features and contours consistently in both designated references and each target PSD.
Separate neutral target facial geometry from reference pose motion and relative depth placement.
Validate feature continuity, shape distortion, coverage and visibility as well as cell orientation, including intermediate and combined poses.
Freeze the shared method and evaluate 5-10 diverse real PSDs without per-model coefficients or patches, including targets independent of the references.
